browserComparison.method: Visible official View Document link via documented browser download API
browserComparison.limitation: The browser returned a file without response headers or a network trace. This does not prove an uncached network response. New controlled HTTP captures have their own metadata; none is transferred into this browser capture or the original 15 October manifest.

conclusion.observedDiscriminator: The browser-style User-Agent was sufficient for the PDF in this bounded comparison; Referer alone and the application-identified User-Agent were not. This is consistent with user-agent-dependent upstream handling; the precise CDN/server mechanism is unverified.
conclusion.supportedOperatorPath: Explicit customFetch/header profile inside the existing ControlledWebRetriever, using captureOfficialDocuments or the opt-in diagnostic CLI. Every host, HTTPS, redirect, MIME/signature, topic, hash and admission check still applies. The compatibility header grants no source trust.
conclusion.productionDependency: The unchanged deployed official-source endpoint still yields maintenance content. A reviewed server-side request-profile decision and successful deployed/browser transport acceptance are required before production integration. The public proxy does not accept arbitrary client-supplied upstream headers; that restriction remains intact.
conclusion.entityBytes: Stored gzip files wrap the exact HTTP entity bytes exposed by fetch, independently hashed after decompression. They are not captures of TLS packets or on-the-wire content encoding.
conclusion.historicalApplicability: No source-supported historical effective interval has been established. Publication and Last-Modified dates are not effective dates.
conclusion.originalPdfSubsection: The original requested Substantive Fund Management Activity extraction remains PDF_SECTION_NOT_SUBSTANTIVE because the following numbered paragraph is treated as a boundary. Whole-document extraction is EXACT but lacks the unique page locator required by the unchanged feed/admission gates. A separately declared paragraph 9 selection supplies the genuine page-3 passage for isolated lifecycle acceptance; it does not establish either original-subsection or whole-document lifecycle acceptance.
